label: Sixth-edition aphorisms
title: Aphorism § 223
text:
§ 223



 But if the antipsoric treatment be omitted, then we may almost
          assuredly expect, from a much slighter cause than brought on the first attack of the
          insanity, the speedy occurrence of a new and more lasting the severe fit, during which the
          psora usually develops itself completely, and passes into either a periodic or continued
          mental derangement, which is then more difficult to be cured by antipsorics.
